position_definitions.down_r23: down middle-to-heaviest singular-value ratio (sigma_2 / sigma_3; equals lepton S/S_tilde at level 5)
position_definitions.down_r13: down lightest-to-heaviest singular-value ratio (sigma_1 / sigma_3; equals lepton S/S_tilde at level 5)

area_measure_detail.method: Compactified u = 1/y integration (dx dy / y^2 = dx du on u in [0, 2/sqrt(3)]); 2D Gauss-Legendre bulk quadrature on y <= 5 (80.90% of area) + 5-panel Gauss-Legendre dynamic arbitrary-precision mpmath SVD quadrature on y in [5, 200] + exact cusp limit on y >= 200.
